correctness.rationale: PASS. Reconstructed the LCF 18-vertex 27-edge graph, signed unordered 153/432/297-cell deleted-product model and d1d2=0. Independently enumerated all 783 cycles and 234 disjoint pairs (45/108/54/27 by lengths), found d2 ranks 270 over F101 and 269 over F2, and recomputed the explicitly indexed 27x27 torus minor determinant +1. Since 27 genuine cycles lie in ker d2 and a unit minor makes their Z-span saturated in ambient Z^297, they integrally equal the entire rank-27 kernel. Independent integral coordinate/SNF replay gives orbit18 (rank17 primitive), orbit27 (rank27, factors 2,2,2,2,2), length 6,6 and 6,8 both basis-generating, length 6,10 factors 2,2,2,2,4 and 8,8 factors 2,2,2,2,2. Full automorphism enumeration yields order216 and orbit sizes18 and27. All finite enumerations are exhaustive for the given fixed graph, not claims about all graphs. The topological model is backed by Barnett--Farber Lemma1.1.
